title: Moses Blesses the Tribes

questions.question: Which tribe is blessed first?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:6 (ESV): "Let Reuben live, and not die..."

questions.question: What is said of Levi's Thummim and Urim?
options: Let them be with your godly one
questions.correctAnswer: Let them be with your godly one
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:8 (ESV): "And of Levi he said, 'Give to Levi your Thummim, and your Urim to your godly one...'"

questions.question: Benjamin is called what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:12 (ESV): "Of Benjamin he said, 'The beloved of the Lord dwells in safety by him...'"

questions.question: Joseph's land is blessed with what?
options: The choicest gifts of heaven above and of the deep
questions.correctAnswer: The choicest gifts of heaven above and of the deep
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:13 (ESV): "...Blessed by the Lord be his land, with the choicest gifts of heaven above..."

questions.question: Naphtali is said to be full of what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:23 (ESV): "O Naphtali, sated with favor, and full of the blessing of the Lord..."

questions.question: Simeon is notably missing from the blessings. Which tribe is mentioned?
questions.explanation: Simeon is not blessed in Deuteronomy 33.

questions.question: Judah is prayed for to be brought to whom?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:7 (ESV): "Hear, O Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him in to his people."

questions.question: Gad is compared to what animal?
Dan is compared to what?
options: A lion's cub that leaps from Bashan
questions.correctAnswer: A lion's cub that leaps from Bashan
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:22 (ESV): "Dan is a lion's cub that leaps from Bashan."

questions.question: Asher is blessed with what regarding his feet?
options: Let him dip his foot in oil
questions.correctAnswer: Let him dip his foot in oil
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:24 (ESV): "let him be the favorite of his brothers, and let him dip his foot in oil."

questions.question: Who are the ten thousands of Ephraim and thousands of Manasseh?
options: The horns of the wild ox (Joseph)
questions.correctAnswer: The horns of the wild ox (Joseph)
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:17 (ESV): "His horns are the horns of a wild ox... Such are the ten thousands of Ephraim..."

questions.question: What is said about Issachar and Zebulun?
options: They shall call peoples to their mountain; they draw from the abundance of the seas
questions.correctAnswer: They shall call peoples to their mountain; they draw from the abundance of the seas
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:18–19 (ESV): "Rejoice, Zebulun... and you, Issachar... They suck the affluence of the seas..."

questions.question: Who rides through the heavens to your help?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:26 (ESV): "There is none like God, O Jeshurun, who rides through the heavens to your help..."

questions.question: What are underneath?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:27 (ESV): "The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms."

questions.question: Levi did what regarding his father and mother?
options: Said, "I have not seen him"; he ignored his kin to keep the covenant
questions.correctAnswer: Said, "I have not seen him"; he ignored his kin to keep the covenant
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 33:9 (ESV): "who said of his father and mother, 'I have not seen them'; he disowned his brothers... for they observed your word..."

key_verse_text: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. And he thrust out the enemy before you and said, “Destroy.” (ESV)
